I felt his grading with pretty lenient where he'd still give 5/10 if I KINDA had it.

reviews.comment: He is an extremely rough grader, you could have the answer right but if it's not detailed enough you will not get credit. Open ended test, be ready to study so much for it to barely pass. There are no other grades to save you in this class.

reviews.comment: Exam heavy class. Be ready to know everything & explain proficiently in free-response explanations. I often got points off for not explaining to a depth he looked for; draw pictures if you can as good ones can replace lengthy word explanations. Don't be afraid to ask questions, study a lot, & consider SI sessions. Overall, great professor & person.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class may seem daunting and scary since there are only 3 exams and 1 final that is worth 1.5x of an exam, and that the exam is free response, however, if you attend class and take notes on his lectures, which he usually provides before class, you could easily maintain a B+. Exams are free-response. Downside is that you cannot messup on any exam
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is only exam based; 3 semester exams, and one final that is worth 1.5 times the other exams. Final's 100 points of new material, 50 points of exam questions from earlier in the semester. Exams can be tough, as its only free response, but focus on taking great notes, and using flashcards to memorize the processes, and you'll get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Graded by 3 exams and a final, can't recover from one bad score. Boring lectures, slides were in a weird order in my opinion, had to use textbook to teach myself. If you take him, know the learning objectives very well for exams and keep all your old exams as he uses exact questions from previous exams for the final.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Can come off as intimidating or monotone, but does have a great understanding of the material. Highly recommend finding a way to record lectures because a lot of information stated can be relevant to his exams, not found in the textbook, or provides contexts to his slides. ALWAYS follow the Learning Objectives. Tough class, but still doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: CHOOSE ANOTHER PROF: You are only graded on 3 exams+Final, ALL WRITTEN. This system/grading policy is bad because you could answer an exam question and still get marks cut off just because it isn't according to the prof's "perfect rubric". Course has no HW so you cannot recover from even 1 bad exam grade. Theres a reason he avgs 15 Q-DROPS a sem.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Every test is a written exam, NO multiple choice. I struggle a lot on written exams. I went to every SI session, read the textbook, did the study guide, but I still struggled in this class. He is also a very slow grader. Most of my classmates did VERY well in this class, with lots of A's on tests. He is accessible and helpful during office hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: ONLY has 3 exams + finals that are all frq, exams have 5 bonus pts (105pts) but u can only get max 100pts for each, nice guy, very boring & jumps around, draws a ton even tho he doesn't need to (its on the projector & usually more confusing). Will give hints to what's on the exam here and there. Overall ok if u study hard and memorize his LOs
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor McKnight was a great professor. He is very knowledgeable and is a very kind person. His class is only graded on exams and they are fairly tough but if you attend every class and note when he points out specific topics as potential exam questions you will be fine. His class is very interesting and he notes how each topic is relevant.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is GREAT. If you study the learning objectives, read the textbook, and do each practice exam to study for the 4 exams there is no reason to not make an A in the class. I highly recommend this Prof. for this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Only grades are 3 midterms and a final, but the learning objectives he gives you are basically word for word test questions. Reading the textbook helps a lot, and he was always open after class for office hours to help with any questions that we had.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: McKnight is good at explaining topics and answering questions. I learned a lot in his class. He is very clear about what you actually need to know for the exams. The exams make up 100% of your grade, but he is not a tough grader. Study the learning objectives and go to class. During lectures he will sometimes say "this will be on the exam".
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is only 3 exams and a final.  He takes forever to grade and return your exams. Literally waits until the class before your next exam to grade them. Even if you are one or two points away from a certain grade at the end of the course he will not bump it up. I would not recommend taking him unless he's your last option.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good prof, very knowledgeable. If you skip class you wont pass. Exams are free response questions, no hw. There are SI sessions and he puts up chapter objectives and practice exams. I read the textbook, made sure I could explain everything on his objectives and made As every test, be prepared to work for the grade.

Dr. McKnight was overall a good professor. He is difficult, his exams are not easy, but he knows his stuff and teaches it in an interesting way. His exams are almost all free response, but everything on them he did teach you in class. Don't skip class. He often says "this will certainly be on the exam *wink wink*." He did curve at the end. Slightly
Had him for scen 102 so not a core class of his. He made learning about biology interesting. I never had any homework from him so take that into account with this review.

reviews.comment: Dr. McKnight was a good professor. His exams came from his learning objectives and were pretty straightforward. Once you get used to his exam style, they arent hard but they were all free response.

reviews.comment: Prof McKnight is the best prof I have had in TAMU. I loved the class and got a B but because I messed in the first test we had. Study from the learning objectives he posts because the questions from the exam are from there. He is an amazing prof and I really learned a lot. Yes, you have to work for the grade but it is doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor McKnight is a great professor in my opinion. He is very passionate about what he teaches which helps when you actually want to learn. Most people did not do well on the first exam because they did not prepare, but McKnight puts chapter objectives which is exactly what you need to know for the exams. SI sessions are really helpful!!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: His lectures are very very very confusing. SI sessions will do all the work. Go to every single one of those and do the learning objectives and really make sure you know them because thats the entire test. Without the SI and doing the learning objectives, I could not pass. He is not the best but the class is doable. You can get an A if you do that
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. McKnight powerpoints arent very detailed to what the actual material is. His lectures are confusing but you can tell he is interested in what hes talking about.
